role: independent delivery verifier (Paper2MCP stage 6, output-delivery.md 'Validate the ZIP itself' steps 1-5)
identity: Fresh agent, the same one that served as independent tool verifier for bulk_enrichment (verifier attempt 2). It never acted as an implementer, environment owner or packager for this run.

archive.entries: 6 files + 4 directories under one top-level decoupler-mcp/

package_content_review.unintended_files: none. Only USAGE.md, src/decoupler_mcp.py, src/requirements.txt, src/tools/{bulk_enrichment.py,__init__.py} and THIRD_PARTY/decoupler-LICENSE.txt are present. There are no tests, fixtures, notebooks, reports, environments, caches, .git or secrets.
package_content_review.verified_production_revision: src/tools/bulk_enrichment.py sha256 9a29baf1f90634a490a818f2e8f835061205fbd42838e3f0d565f1a93833a039 is the independently verified revision. All packaged src/ files are byte-equal to the workspace src/.
package_content_review.developer_machine_paths: none in USAGE.md, src/ or THIRD_PARTY/. The only grep hit is the relative '<package>/tmp/outputs/bulk_enrichment/'.
package_content_review.scientific_code_provenance: decoupler is not vendored. It is installed from git+https://github.com/scverse/decoupler@27a1be7c75d88306bf3c2e4d0e7fb4b42d48f78a, and its BSD-3 license and provenance are in THIRD_PARTY/.

extraction.permissions: Files 0644 and directories 0755, the same as recorded in the archive. No file needs an executable bit, because the server starts as '.venv/bin/python src/decoupler_mcp.py' per USAGE.md. No permission-restoration step is needed.

installation.source: extracted USAGE.md 'Install' section, followed literally from the extracted decoupler-mcp/ folder with VIRTUAL_ENV, PYTHONPATH and PYTHONHOME unset (none were set in the shell either)
installation.note_on_brief: The coordinator brief paraphrased the commands as 'uv pip install -r src/requirements.txt' and 'uv pip check'. USAGE.md, which I was asked to follow literally, passes --python .venv/bin/python. I ran the USAGE.md form.
installation.cache: The install was served from the local uv cache (resolved in 285 ms). I separately ran a cache-free dry-run resolution ('uv pip install --dry-run --no-cache --python <probe venv> -r src/requirements.txt', exit 0): it resolved all 128 pins against live PyPI and a fresh GitHub clone of the pinned commit in 2.86 s. That run did not download wheels. Log: tmp/delivery/nocache_dry_run.log.
installation.import_origin: decoupler, pydeseq2, scanpy, anndata, fastmcp, numpy, pandas and igraph all import from the extracted .venv; none comes from the build workspace, and the workspace is not on sys.path.
installation.decoupler_pinned_commit: direct_url.json vcs_info.commit_id = 27a1be7c75d88306bf3c2e4d0e7fb4b42d48f78a (matches the pin). The installed package source is byte-identical to repo/decoupler/src/decoupler (diff -rq exit 0, tmp/delivery/decoupler_source_diff.txt).

acceptance_cases.command: cd '<extract>/decoupler-mcp' && env -u VIRTUAL_ENV -u PYTHONPATH -u PYTHONHOME .venv/bin/python -I $SKILL/scripts/verify_mcp_server.py --server '<extract>/decoupler-mcp/src/decoupler_mcp.py' --expected reports/expected-mcp-tools.json --cases tmp/delivery/mcp-acceptance-cases.relocated.json --require-all-tools --cwd '<extract>/decoupler-mcp' --call-timeout 900 --report tmp/delivery/mcp-delivery-acceptance.json
acceptance_cases.stderr_note: stderr (tmp/delivery/acceptance.err) contains FastMCP rich tracebacks for the 11 expected-error cases. Every stdout line was JSON-RPC, since the helper parsed all of them.

scientific_comparisons.method: Real MCP calls over stdio to the extracted server (its .venv python, cwd = extracted folder), chained filter -> DE -> ulm -> inspect on the relocated inputs, using network_path snapshots. Expected values come from notebooks/bulk_rna/reference (read only, client side). Script: tmp/delivery/science_checks.py.
scientific_comparisons.tolerance: 0 (bitwise). Same platform as the reference run; the executor replays and the independent verifier suite were bitwise reproducible; float64 CSV values reload exactly with pandas 3.

error_missing_group_level.error_text: Error calling tool 'pydeseq2_test_differential_expression': level(s) ['TGFb'] not found in adata.obs['condition']; available levels: ['control', 'treatment']

default_output_base.observed: With output_dir omitted, artifacts were written to <extract>/decoupler-mcp/tmp/outputs/bulk_enrichment/ulm_hallmark_<stamp>_<uuid>/. Nothing new appeared under the build workspace tmp/outputs.

observations_not_defects: Expected-error calls print full rich tracebacks to the server stderr (FastMCP logging). This is harmless for stdio, but noisy in client logs.
The coordinator brief's install-command paraphrase omitted the --python .venv/bin/python flag that USAGE.md uses; USAGE.md itself is consistent and worked.
remaining_limits: Validated only on Linux x86_64 (WSL2, glibc 2.39), on the same machine as the build, with the same uv-managed CPython 3.13.12 base interpreter. Other OSes and architectures were not tested.
The actual install came from the local uv cache. The cache-free check was a dry-run resolution and did not download wheels.
Bitwise equality is specific to this platform and BLAS (OpenBLAS); cross-platform numerical variation was not measured.
Live network downloads (Zenodo, OmniPath) were not used in the delivery checks; all calls used network_path snapshots. The verifier suite's live tests matched the snapshots on 2026-10-28.
Figures were checked only for existence (min_artifacts / artifact paths); figure content was compared in the development verifier suite, not here.
The 'fastmcp install claude-code' command in USAGE.md was not executed, and client registration was not tested.
